# Memberstack

Memberstack is a platform that enables developers to add user authentication, payments, and member management to their websites without writing backend code.

Category: Security & Ops. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/memberstack/.

## Actions

- **Create Member**: Create a new member in your application.
- **Delete Member**: Permanently delete a member from your application.
- **Get Member** (read-only): Retrieve a specific member by id or email.
- **List Members** (read-only): Retrieve a paginated list of all members in your application.
- **List Plans** (read-only): List all available membership plans.
- **Remove Free Plan**: Remove a free plan from an existing member.
- **Update Member**: Update an existing member's information.
